title: Unit normalization of the pullback composition mate
statement: Fix unbounded derived categories of module sheaves on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. For schemes X,Y,Z [def-pc-scheme] and morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y→Z, let p(f,g):Lg* followed by Lf* ≅ L(fg)* be the fixed comparison of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], and a(t) the pinned adjunction of [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction, def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For every homotopy complex K of O_X-modules, the right-derived unit for (fg)_* followed by the component at QK of conjugateEquiv(a(fg),a(g).comp(a(f)),p(f,g).hom) equals the unit for g_* at f_*K followed by Rg_* of the unit for f_* at K. The right-derived units are those of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. No square, direct-image composition comparison, flatness, boundedness or preservation of K-injectives is assumed.

source.place: Tags 079W (lemma-adjoint), 0D5S (lemma-derived-pullback-composition) and 0D5T (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); single-pair normalization step of lem-sc-derived-direct-image-square-mate. The cited tag pages were read online.

proof.text: Compute the transpose of beta(fg) followed by the mate of p by the conjugate counit identity and naturality of p. The chosen-comparison counit normalization identifies it with the explicit pasted underived counits.

A private formal mate calculation identifies the composite unit followed by the mate with the forward composite Hom equivalence of the chosen-comparison transpose. Substitute the chosen-comparison normalization, then the proved forward pasted-unit normalization. Transitivity gives the unit equation.

proof_origin.note: Complete formal transposition proof from two counit subcalculations. The pasted-unit subcalculation is proved; the chosen-comparison subcalculation remains one named theorem. No K-flat roof extension is required for the counit-based route.

theorem derivedPullbackComposition_mate_unit
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    let p : ∀ {A B C : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) (t : B ⟶ C),
        derivedPullback t ⋙ derivedPullback s ≅ derivedPullback (s ≫ t) :=
      @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})))
    (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
        (conjugateEquiv (schemeHomPullbackAdjunction.{u, w} (f ≫ g))
          ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction.{u, w} g).comp (schemeHomPullbackAdjunction.{u, w} f))
          (p f g).hom).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
          (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).map
          ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K)
